subject: Private pilot: technical window confirmation + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@medalign.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: infra@medalign.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private pilot intake (self-serve) — next steps

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick follow-up — I just finished the self-serve sign-up and the team is excited to run a short on-prem pilot before we commit to a Dedicated capacity plan. We have two asks up front: a short technical smoke test (30–45m) to validate network/connectivity and a checklist of evidence we should prepare for security/compliance.

High-level constraints: most of our infra team is in PST; we need a time that works for 10am–2pm PST on weekdays. Also we have a strict allowlist and will need approximate IP ranges ahead of time.

Attendees likely: me (Head of Infra), Michael Chen (Platform Lead), a security engineer (TBD).

Can your team propose two windows this week and share the minimal evidence pack (SOC2, encryption controls, network template)?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Torres
Head of Infrastructure, MedAlign Health
emma.torres@medalign.com

---
Attachment: sign-up-confirmation.pdf (stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@medalign.com>, Infra Team <infra@medalign.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot intake (self-serve) — next steps

Hi Emma — welcome and thanks for signing up. Great to meet you. I work on the Solutions team and will coordinate the pilot logistics.

Quick answers up front:
- We can run the technical smoke test and a short walkthrough of our Private/VPC deployment options in a 45-minute session.
- I attached a concise evidence pack and a network-topology template for your infra team to fill out.
- We’ll provide our expected egress IP ranges and a stubbed allowlist by EOD tomorrow, and we can work with your VPN/bastion model if needed.

Proposed windows this week (all PST):
1) Tue 20 Jul — 10:30–11:15am
2) Wed 21 Jul — 1:00–1:45pm

If neither works, share two slots that fit your team and we’ll prioritize.

Next steps I suggest:
- Pick a slot (we’ll send calendar invite with bridge and read-only artifacts)
- Michael or your security engineer drop the filled network-topology-template.xlsx a copy to the shared folder
- We run the smoke test; if green, we follow with a brief runbook handoff to your SREs and a procurement touchpoint for pilot terms.

Thanks — sending the evidence pack now.

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-onprem-ops-checklist.md (stub); SOC2-summary.pdf (stub); network-topology-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medalign.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Emma Torres <emma.torres@medalign.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 07:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot intake (self-serve) — next steps

Vanessa — thanks. Wed 21 Jul 1:00pm PST works best for us. I’m the technical lead and I’ll be on the call.

Quick note on constraints so the smoke test scope is clear:
- We will not allow inbound SSH from unknown IPs; connectivity will be via outbound peering or an approved bastion.
- We require evidence of encryption at rest and in transit and a brief KMS integration note.
- Can you include a short list of the commands/logs we should expect to see during the smoke test so our on-call SRE knows what to watch?

I’ll drop the network-topology-template.xlsx back to the Drive by EOD after I confirm with our security engineer.

-Michael
Michael Chen
Platform Lead, MedAlign Health

- Confirm attendee emails and roles

Agenda (45m):
1) 5m — introductions & success criteria (Emma)
2) 15m — network/connectivity smoke test (bastion / outbound peering)
3) 10m — KMS and key handling overview (what we need from you)
